<function name="Unpack" parent="Angle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the pitch, yaw, and roll components of the angle.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">p, pitch, x, or Angle[1].</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">y, yaw, or Angle[2].</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">r, roll, r, or Angle[3].</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
